design.floodHazard.value: Floodplain ordinance 12/12/1983; FIS dated 6/19/2020 (panels per Boise sheet)

garage.gypsumGarageSide.amendment: Idaho replaced Table R302.6 with 5/8 in Type X on garage side (base 2018 is 1/2 in)

garage.gypsumCeilingUnderHabitable.amendment: Idaho Table R302.6 replacement: 5/8 in Type X

footing.minDepthBelowGrade.amendment: Idaho replaced Table R403.1 footing widths and R403.1.1 sizes

vent.wholeHouseCfmPerSqFt.amendment: Idaho R303.4 requires whole-house mechanical ventilation per M1505.4

plumbing.waterHeaterTPRDischarge.value: Discharge pipe to a safe visible spot; no valve in the line

elec.counterReceptacleMaxDistance.amendment: Idaho added 210.52(C)(4) for island/peninsula receptacle mounting

elec.gfciLocations.amendment: IDAPA 24.39.10.600 amends 210.8(A): deletes (7) food-prep sinks and (11) laundry, limits basements to unfinished, drops 250 V

elec.afciLocations.amendment: IDAPA 24.39.10.600: AFCI only for bedroom circuits/outlets in 1- and 2-family dwellings

energy.glazedSHGC.amendment: Idaho table: SHGC not required in zones 5-6

energy.ceilingR.amendment: Idaho replaced zone 5 ceiling R-49 (base 2018 IECC) with R-38

energy.airLeakageACH50.amendment: Idaho: at least 20% of a builder's homes must be tested from 7/1/2021; visual inspection option added

energy.ductTestRequired.value: Total duct leakage at most 4 cfm25 per 100 sq ft, tested at rough-in (3 without the air handler) or after construction

fire.ratedWallDistance.amendment: Idaho replaced Table R302.1(1) (IDAPA 24.39.30.600); Boise City Code 9-1B-35 repeats it

fire.noOpeningsDistance.amendment: Idaho replaced Table R302.1(1) (IDAPA 24.39.30.600); Boise City Code 9-1B-35 repeats it

fire.projectionMinDistance.amendment: Idaho replaced Table R302.1(1) (IDAPA 24.39.30.600); Boise City Code 9-1B-35 repeats it

elec.receptacleMaxHeight.amendment: None to 210.52(A); Idaho amends only 210.52(E)(3) (balcony/deck/porch receptacle max 6.5 ft above surface).

elec.islandReceptacleRequired.amendment: Idaho adds 210.52(C) list item (4): receptacles may be mounted up to 12 in below the countertop, but not where the counter extends more than 6 in beyond its support base. Does not restore the island requirement.

smoke.interconnected.amendment: Idaho/Boise only delete Exception #2 of R314.2.2 (alterations/additions); R314.4 itself unchanged.

smoke.garageHeatAlarm.amendment: Boise City Code 9-1B-42 adds R314.7.5: a listed heat detector, wired to the smoke alarms, in attached garages (and detached ones with power that lack fire separation distance).

co.outsideSleepingAreas.amendment: Idaho/Boise delete only Exception #2 of R315.2.2; IDAPA 24.39.70 also adds M1203.1 CO alarms where permitted work occurs in existing dwellings.

mech.dryerExhaustMaxLength.amendment: None to this section. Idaho amends M1502.4.2 only (duct support at 4 ft intervals etc.).

mech.garageIgnitionHeight.amendment: Idaho ISPC (24.39.20) replaces UPC 507.13: ignition sources in residential garages at least 18 in above floor unless listed flammable-vapor-ignition-resistant (same number).

plumbing.dfu.clothesWasher.amendment: Idaho amends Table 702.1: clothes washer, domestic, private = 2 DFU (base UPC 3).

plumbing.wsfu.clothesWasher.amendment: Idaho amends Table 610.3 (and App. A Table A103.1): clothes washer = 2 WSFU public and private (base 2015 UPC private 4.0).

plumbing.wsfu.bathtub.amendment: Idaho amends Table 610.3: bathtub or combination bath/shower = 2 WSFU public and private (base 2015 UPC private 4.0).

plumbing.hoseBibBackflow.value: Frost-free, self-draining hose bib with built-in backflow protection (vacuum breaker)
plumbing.hoseBibBackflow.amendment: Idaho replaces UPC 603.5.7 (adds frost-proof self-draining requirement for freezing climates).

energy.programmableThermostat.amendment: None. (Idaho 03.p amends IRC R403.1.1 footing size, a different section.)

energy.highEfficacyLampsPct.amendment: None found (R404.1 only referenced in new R402.6 log homes).

struct.seismicBracingExempt.amendment: Idaho amends R602.10 to allow R602.12 or APA SR-102 as alternatives.

struct.footingsLightFrame.amendment: IDAPA 24.39.30.600: R403.1(1)-(3) deleted, Table R403.1 added

struct.plainConcreteWall.section: Table R404.1.2(3) (8-inch flat basement wall, vertical reinforcement)

struct.trussDesign.value: R802.10.1 trusses designed per ANSI/TPI 1; R802.10.2 truss design drawings delivered with trusses to the job site and approved

struct.trussBracing.value: R802.10.3 (truss member bracing per the design drawings / BCSI)

struct.roofUplift.value: R802.11: roof assemblies need uplift connections (hurricane ties or equivalent) from rafter/truss to wall; required uplift comes from Table R802.11 by wind speed, exposure, roof span, pitch and overhang, or from truss design drawings; deduct 0.60 dead load; plus continuous load path to foundation (R606/R403).

struct.bracingWind.unit: ft of braced panel per braced wall line
struct.bracingWind.section: Table R602.10.3(1), band up to 115 mph Vult
struct.bracingWind.amendment: Idaho allows R602.12 or APA SR-102 in place of R602.10 (IDAPA 24.39.30.600)

struct.portalFrameNote.value: PFH (R602.10.6.2): panel at least 16 in (roof only) or 24 in (one story plus roof) wide, header span 6 to 18 ft, 3/8 in WSP nailed 3 in o.c., a 5/8 in anchor bolt plus 3500 lb hold-down at one side and a 1000 lb strap opposite; for walls up to 12 ft, portal height up to 10 ft, pony wall up to 4 ft with tension straps. CS-PF (R602.10.6.4): continuous-sheathing portal, tension strap capacity from Table R602.10.6.4 (example 1200 lbf at 115 mph Exp B).

struct.headerNonBearing.value: R602.7.4: load-bearing headers are not required in interior or exterior nonbearing walls; a single flat 2x4 may serve as the header for openings up to 8 ft wide when the distance to the nailing surface above is 24 in or less, and no cripples or blocking are needed above it.
